scripts.build:extension: ~/.bun/bin/bun build src/content.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --minify && ~/.bun/bin/bun build src/popup.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --minify && ~/.bun/bin/bun build src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --minify && tailwindcss -i src/popup.css -o dist/popup.css --minify && cp src/content.css dist/ && cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:watch: ~/.bun/bin/bun build src/content.tsx src/popup.tsx src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --watch & tailwindcss -i src/popup.css -o dist/popup.css --watch & cp src/content.css dist/ && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
